name: HashMap
desc: A templated key-value map. In C++ Mode, std::map and std::unordered_map from the standard library are often more idiomatic, but HashMap is available for Processing Java compatibility.
syntax:
HashMap<std::string, int> map
map.put("key", 1)
int v = map.get("key")

methods.name: put(K k, V v)
methods.desc: Inserts or updates a key-value pair

methods.name: get(K k)
methods.desc: Returns reference to value for key

methods.name: keySet()
methods.desc: Returns a vector of all keys

methods.name: values()
methods.desc: Returns a vector of all values
